description: This file defines classes and structures related to building and verifying certificate paths, including CertPathBuilder, CertPathBuilderResultPath, and CertPathBuilderDelegate, used for certificate chain validation in the Chromium project.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegateData
classes.description: Base class for custom data attached to certificate paths during path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a candidate or validated certificate path, including its validity, trust status, policies, errors, and delegate data.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: Interface for controlling policies during certificate verification and path building, including post-verification checks and deadline management.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building and verifying certificate paths to trust anchors, supporting configuration of issuer sources, limits, and path exploration.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Nested structure within CertPathBuilder representing the overall outcome of path building, including paths attempted, best path, errors, and limits.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Called after RFC 5280 verification to allow delegate to reject or accept candidate paths.

methods.name: IsDeadlineExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the path building process should be terminated due to deadline expiry.

methods.name: CertPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the path builder with target certificate, trust store, delegate, and verification parameters.

methods.name: AddCertIssuerSource
methods.description: Adds an issuer source for intermediate certificates during path building.

methods.name: SetIterationLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of iterations for path consideration.

methods.name: SetDepthLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum depth of certificate chains.

methods.name: SetExploreAllPaths
methods.description: Configures whether to explore all possible paths or stop at the first valid one.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the certificate path verification process.
